fees.notes: HELP University does not publish an international student fee for this programme: the official programme page lists only the Malaysian-student indicative total fee (RM 17,800), and the 2026 HELP University Programme Fees Summary (v4, July 2026) is explicitly Malaysian-only. Sources checked on 2026-09-18: https://university.help.edu.my/programme/foundation-in-arts/; https://university.help.edu.my/admissions-study-awards/fee-schedule/ (page empty); https://university.help.edu.my/admissions-study-awards/international-student-admissions/; https://university.help.edu.my/brochures/ (2026 fees summary PDF). No international fee published.

description: HELP's Foundation programme equips students with skills, knowledge and qualifications to pursue a degree at university. Covers various areas essential for contemporary education.
